notes: A separate policy because the ceilings mean different things here. Tolerance is 0.05 rather than 0.50: TDS is computed to the paisa from a statutory rate, so anything above rounding is a rate applied wrongly and must be raised rather than absorbed. The write-off ceiling is 100.00 because a TDS credit written off is tax paid and never claimed, which is real money out of the business, not a housekeeping entry.
